name: budget-before-a-loop
query: I want a watcher that summarizes BTC news every 5 minutes for 24 hours, about 3,000 input and 300 output tokens per call. Can my AI budget cover it on a cheap model and on a strong one? Don't start it, just tell me.
expected_behavior: Reads the budget from GET /balance, binference:get_balance or scripts/budget.mjs, using the key's remaining_usd when it is lower than spendable_usd
Prices both models from the live GET /models list, not from memory, at 288 calls
States the cost per call and per day for each model and a verdict against the budget
Does not start the watcher, and does not print the key

name: vision-model-on-a-chart
query: Send chart.png to the cheapest bInference model that can read images and show me its two-sentence description of the trend.
expected_behavior: Finds the cheapest model whose input_modalities include image, from the live list
Sends the image inline when small, or through scripts/upload.mjs and its link when over 4 MB
Sets max_tokens on the call and does not print the key
Shows that model's answer without adding numbers it cannot read

name: verified-recap-card
query: Make a recap card image for my trade: BNB/USDT, bought at 600.00, sold at 642.00, PnL +7.00%, Oct 1 to Oct 3.
expected_behavior: Chooses an image model from GET /images/models and asks for response_format url
Puts only the given numbers on the card
Reads the card back with a model that reads images and compares every number
Regenerates when a number differs, and shows the card without posting it anywhere

name: two-kinds-of-balance
query: My agent's model calls fail with 402 insufficient_balance, but my Binance account has funds. What's wrong?
expected_behavior: Explains that the bInference AI budget and the Binance account are separate balances
Checks the AI budget and what running calls reserve
Suggests lowering max_tokens, a cheaper model, waiting for running calls, or adding credit
